connector.name: MCP by sonenta.com
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for Sonenta translation management: keys, translations, a11y, and source-health tools.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.sonenta, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: SONENTA_API_KEY
env.description: Sonenta API key (mcp:* scope). If omitted, the server reads it from ~/.sonenta/credentials (run `sonenta login`). Legacy SONENTA_TOKEN / VERBUMIA_API_KEY / VERBUMIA_TOKEN are also accepted.

env.name: SONENTA_PROJECTS
env.description: Comma-separated project UUIDs to scope the server to. Optional; use SONENTA_PROJECT for a single project.

env.name: SONENTA_AGENT_NAME
env.description: Optional agent identity — a short run name that groups this session's work in the Sonenta dashboard.

env.name: SONENTA_AGENT_TYPE
env.description: Optional agent identity — the agent kind (e.g. sonenta-i18n, sonenta-a11y).

env.name: SONENTA_AGENT_VERSION
env.description: Optional agent identity — the agent version. Defaults to the server's own version when unset.

recipes.cli: claude mcp add mcp --env SONENTA_API_KEY=<your-sonenta-api-key> --env SONENTA_API_BASE=https://api.sonenta.dev --env SONENTA_PROJECTS=<sonenta-projects> --env SONENTA_AGENT_NAME=<sonenta-agent-name> --env SONENTA_AGENT_TYPE=<sonenta-agent-type> --env SONENTA_AGENT_VERSION=<sonenta-agent-version> -- npx -y @sonenta/mcp@0.46.2

recipes.code:
[mcp_servers.mcp]
command = "npx"
args = ["-y", "@sonenta/mcp@0.46.2"]

[mcp_servers.mcp.env]
SONENTA_API_KEY = "<your-sonenta-api-key>"
SONENTA_API_BASE = "https://api.sonenta.dev"
SONENTA_PROJECTS = "<sonenta-projects>"
SONENTA_AGENT_NAME = "<sonenta-agent-name>"
